name: Nodeletter
description: Create and send newsletters based on content nodes via Mailchimp.
project_description:
Nodeletter allows content editors to send nodes as e-mails through third party newsletter services. It provides out-of-the-box support for Mailchimp.

 It uses Drupal nodes as the source of newsletter content and maps node field data to predefined templates managed on an external provider.

 The module is designed to keep the editorial workflow inside Drupal. Editors can prepare newsletter content using familiar Drupal content types and fields, while the external delivery provider remains abstracted behind the integration layer.
